description: Q0.31 acc_scale variant of chipyard_dual_gemmini.json — same SoC topology (alveo_u250_firesim-dual-rocket-saturn-gemmini-q31-no-nic-l2-llc4mb-ddr3, MP_MAX_NUM_CPUS=2), gemmini0 swapped for gemmini_q31_0 (HW im2col + bit-exact int Q0.31 mvout). Hart 0 = gemmini-attached (CPU_P), hart 1 = saturn-RVV-only (CPU_E).

cores.name: gemmini_q31_0
cores.description: Rocket with saturn vector + gemmini Q0.31 accelerator. Routes int8 conv2d/linear via gemmini's ROCC tiled_conv_auto path with Q0.31 acc_scale fold; falls back to scalar/RVV for ops gemmini can't accelerate.

cores.name: rvv0
cores.description: Rocket with saturn vector only (no gemmini). Handles RVV-int8 conv2d / linear, plus all the non-int8 / non-conv ops (silu, sigmoid, batchnorm, maxpool, relu, add, cat, upsample) that fall back to scalar/RVV everywhere.
